balades.name: The Sèvre Nantaise to Clisson
balades.text: The banks of the Sèvre, the Chaussée des Moines at Vertou, the Muscadet vineyards, then Clisson's medieval castle.

balades.name: The Loire banks to Oudon
balades.text: One of the most beautiful stretches of the Loire à Vélo, via Mauves-sur-Loire and Le Cellier, almost entirely traffic-free.

balades.name: The Loire à Vélo to Cordemais
balades.text: The estuary marshes, herons and the Villa Cheminée, an artwork perched 15 metres up facing the river.

balades.name: Lac de Grand-Lieu
balades.text: From the Memorial to the Abolition of Slavery to the Maison du Lac at Bouaye, with an optional out-and-back to Pierre-Aigüe.

balades.name: The Nantes panorama loop
balades.text: Follow Nantes' Green Line by bike: monuments, Voyage à Nantes artworks and the city's quirky corners.

balades.name: The Erdre to Sucé-sur-Erdre
balades.text: “The most beautiful river in France”, according to King François I, with its châteaux and riverside guinguettes.

balades.name: Mauves-sur-Loire
balades.back: Back along the Divatte embankment or by TER train
balades.text: The riverside guinguettes of Sainte-Luce-sur-Loire and Mauves – ideal for families.

balades.name: Le Pellerin via the south bank
balades.back: Back by bike or by ferry to Couëron
balades.text: Trentemoult, Rezé, then the marshes south of the estuary to the port of Le Pellerin.

balades.name: Nantes – Pornic in two days
balades.back: TER train back from Pornic (40 min)
balades.text: The Estuaire trail, the Martinière canal, a night in Paimbœuf or Corsept, then the ocean at Saint-Brevin and the Côte de Jade.

balades.name: Nantes – Angers in two days
balades.back: TER train back from Angers (40 min)
balades.text: Two stages of around 55 km on the Loire à Vélo, through Loire villages, vineyards and wetlands.

balades.name: Nantes – Saint-Nazaire via the Vélidéale
balades.back: TER or TGV train back (40 min)
balades.text: The north side of the estuary through the marshes: The Settlers, the Villa Cheminée and the Lavau-sur-Loire observatory.
